name: pombity
description: Texting for your application, with the compliance built in: SMS and email over the Pombity MCP server.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to Pombity (Aric Communication Service) through its remote MCP server at https://mcp.pombity.com/mcp. Eight tools: send_text, send_email, preview_message, check_consent, get_delivery_report, get_usage, request_verified_destination, confirm_verified_destination. Consent, STOP/HELP, quiet hours, verified destinations, and quotas are enforced server-side; every refusal carries a named error code. Get a key at https://docs.pombity.com — a sandbox key (ak_test_…) sends nothing to a carrier and returns realistic delivery reports.
